decisive_diff.conclusion: The bytes responsible for all three findings are unchanged signing fixtures. Current full source contents equal the pinned upstream archive; no compromise-specific diff explains the flags. Earlier archive rescans with the current baseline rules also give H1/S2, refuting a release-specific behavior change.

reverse_engineering: CoreLibCrossARM.dll is ARM cross-generated System.Private.CoreLib 4.0.0.0, with 1799 types and 20079 methods; CLR entry-point token is zero. Build banner points to 2018 CoreCLR revision a7373500e83e356998853e80a10214a0f9389b5d.

The 2592-character alphabet-only match at file offset 8076771 is loaded by System.Globalization.LocaleData.GetThreeLetterWindowsLanguageName (RVA 0x65981c, string token 0x70015bc5). It indexes via SearchCultureName and Substring; it is not fed to Base64 decoding or assembly loading.

The two managed resources are FxResources.System.Private.CoreLib.SR.resources (157503 bytes, ordinary .resources messages) and System.Private.CoreLib.xml (46514 bytes, linker type/method preservation declarations). Neither is a hidden assembly stage.

IL for AssemblyLoadContext.add_AssemblyResolve combines delegates and uses Interlocked.CompareExchange; OnAssemblyResolve dispatches registered resolvers. Assembly.Load(byte[]) wraps caller-supplied bytes in MemoryStreams and calls LoadFromStream. RuntimeAssembly.get_EntryPoint queries a native assembly handle. These are core runtime implementations, not a resource-to-payload path.

SignToolTests.CrossGenerated passes CoreLibCrossARM.dll to signing configuration generation; MissingStrongNameSignaturesDoNotValidate explicitly expects its signature to be absent. It is not activated as a program by these tests.

Nested ProjectOne/ContainerOne/VisualStudio.Mac.Banana DLLs have Microsoft company metadata and local Debug PDB paths. Examined ProjectOne and Simple1 contain only a constructor calling Object..ctor and returning. The former are honest empty signing fixtures; the latter really have a DLL header flag under .exe filenames.

Additional source changes include explicit Azure TokenCredential bearer-token refresh, moved ExecWithRetries build code, Helix test runners, dependency/tool updates and CI changes. Reviewed MSBuild/XHarness paths locate compilers, install pinned SDKs, run performance tests, and download/extract/run Apple test apps. Their execution and chmod capabilities already have notable detections.
